notes: διὰ τοῦτο is spread over words answering to each token, so rule 45's closing clause applies: 'For … cause' to the preposition headed on 'for', 'this' to the demonstrative — the head that rule 46 contrasts with χάριν.
τε is unrepresented because the ASV writes one connective, which answers to γάρ (rule 70's single-conjunction arm).
τήν → 'that which' heads on 'that' (rule 77) and παρά carries the supplied copula of the verbless relative clause (rules 31, 53).
